learning_outcomes.text: Students have the methodical and practical competence to design and analyze logic circuits.
Students are familiar with different approaches to designing an instruction set architecture and understand their impact on hardware design.
Students understand the basic structure of computers and the interaction of hardware, system software, and communication technologies within the computer.
Students have advanced knowledge regarding the basic concepts, methods, and tools for programming.
Students are qualified for the competent application of these disciplines to practical problems.

syllabus_topics: Types, representation and processing of information
Design and simulation of fundamental logic components (multiplexers, counters, adders, ALU)
Fundamentals of instruction set and processor architecture
Communication in the computer/controller (protocols, control, encoding, compression)
Procedural, modular, and fundamental object-oriented programming concepts using a relevant programming language
